game.label: Your disc image of PokéPark 2: Wonders Beyond, the European Wii release (S2LP01): .iso, .rvz, .wbfs, .wia, .ciso, .gcz or .nfs. The USA and Japanese releases don't work.

prepare.label: Builds the game from your disc: downloads the build tools, then translates and compiles the game code. About 5 minutes.

exit_codes.3: The update was stopped before the end. It starts again the next time you play.
exit_codes.4: The new version could not be built. The details are in logs/install.log in the game's folder.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: Draws the game at a multiple of the Wii's resolution: sharper, but heavier on the graphics card.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.help: 30 or 60 as on the Wii (60 works perfectly), 45 in between. 90 to 240 add images between the game's own frames, up to your screen's refresh rate. Movies and cutscenes stay at 30.

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Full screen fills the whole screen. F11 switches it at any time.

settings.label: Picture shape
settings.help: 16:9 as on the Wii, or 4:3 as on an old TV. 16:10, 21:9 and 32:9 show more of the world around the picture; Fit window follows the window's shape.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: Waits for the screen's refresh to avoid tearing, at the cost of a little latency.

settings.label: Smoothing
settings.help: Smooths jagged edges.

settings.label: Texture filtering
settings.help: Keeps textures sharp when seen at an angle, such as the ground in the distance.

settings.label: Brightness
settings.help: Makes the whole picture lighter or darker. 100% is the original picture.

settings.label: Contrast
settings.help: Widens or narrows the gap between the dark and the light areas. 100% is the original picture.

settings.label: Saturation
settings.help: 0% is black and white, 200% gives very vivid colors. 100% is the original picture.

settings.label: Gamma
settings.help: Lightens or darkens the dark areas without burning out the light ones. 100% is the original picture.

settings.label: Text speed
settings.help: How fast dialogue is written: as in the game, 2 or 3 times faster, or a whole page at once.

settings.label: Skip cutscenes
settings.help: Hold A or + (Start, Tab) for a second to skip a video. During a story scene, hold + for a second to skip it; it stops at questions so you can answer.

settings.label: Button icons
settings.help: Shows the keys and buttons you set in Controls instead of the Wii Remote's, in the game's texts, its action bubble and the title screen.

settings.label: Save photos as PNG
settings.help: Each photo you save in the game is also written in full resolution to the photos folder next to the game.

settings.label: Save backups kept
settings.help: How many copies of your save are kept; one is made each time the game starts.

settings.label: Show the game in Discord
settings.help: Shows on your Discord profile that you are playing PokéPark 2.

settings.label: Show FPS
settings.help: Adds the frame rate to the window's title bar.

settings.label: Volume
settings.help: Volume of the game's sound and music, in percent.

settings.label: Mute
settings.help: Silences the game without changing the volume.

settings.label: Wii Remote speaker
settings.help: Plays the sounds meant for the Wii Remote's speaker on your computer.

settings.label: Free camera
settings.help: Turn the camera around Pikachu with the mouse or the right stick. Off keeps the game's own camera.

settings.label: Mouse camera speed
settings.help: How fast the camera turns when you move the mouse, in percent.

settings.label: Stick camera speed
settings.help: How fast the camera turns with the right stick, in percent.

settings.label: Invert camera up/down
settings.help: Moving up looks down and moving down looks up.

settings.label: Hide the mouse cursor
settings.help: Hides the mouse cursor over the game window.

settings.label: Gamepads
settings.help: Lets gamepads play as Wii Remotes, even when the window is in the background.

settings.label: Vibration
settings.help: Makes the gamepad vibrate when the Wii Remote would.

settings.label: Stick dead zone
settings.help: How far the stick must move before the game reacts, in percent.

settings.label: Game language
settings.help: Language of the game's text. System follows your computer's language.

settings.label: Menu language
settings.help: Language of the game's options menu (F1) and of the window's title bar.

settings.label: Performance overlay
settings.help: Shows the frame rate, processor, graphics card and memory figures in a corner; F2 does the same.

settings.label: Overlay detail
settings.help: Minimal shows the frame rate only, Standard adds the main figures, Full shows everything.

settings.label: Overlay corner
settings.help: Corner of the window where the performance overlay sits.

settings.label: Custom textures
settings.help: Uses the replacement textures installed in the textures folder, such as the HD copies made by tools/hd_textures.py.

settings.label: Dump textures
settings.help: Saves every texture the game loads to disk, to make replacement textures.

settings.label: Bug recorder
settings.help: Keeps the last three seconds of images in graphics memory: the screenshot key (F9) then saves them all, to show a display bug.

settings.label: Check for updates
settings.help: At start, asks GitHub for the latest release. Nothing is downloaded by itself.

actions.label: Save backups
actions.help: The copies of your save the game keeps. One is made each time the game starts.
